description: This file defines a PHP class that extends the HTMLPurifier HTMLModule to add support for the 'nofollow' attribute transformation to anchor tags ('a' elements). It registers a transformation that modifies links to include rel='nofollow'.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Nofollow
classes.description: A class that extends HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule to add support for the 'nofollow' attribute transformation on anchor ('a') tags.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the module by adding an anchor ('a') element and attaching the 'Nofollow' attribute transformation to it.
